en: Black‑and‑white panoramic view of a small Central European town in a hilly landscape. In the left foreground stands a tall church with a clock tower and slender spire topped by a cross. Around it are dense roofs of traditional masonry houses with steep gabled roofs. To the right, on slightly higher ground and partly behind trees, is a castle‑like complex with cylindrical towers and conical roofs. The town is surrounded by fields, meadows, and low wooded hills under an open sky. There is no visible printed caption or other text on the image side.
